sampling.command_template: sample total resident bytes for the release collector pid and append timestamp,rss_bytes

steps: Build the diagnostics collector with the release profile for the named target and record the exact binary SHA-256.
Start with an empty arena, warm for 30 seconds and 10000 records, then reset counters before measurement.
Run all ingest, query, tail, and export clients concurrently for 300 seconds at the fixed rates.
Inject each oversized record, hold one slow tail reader, and fail the exporter at the fixed record count without stopping other clients.
Sample total process RSS every 250 ms from warm-up end through a 30-second post-load drain; do not substitute retained payload bytes.
Fail if any RSS sample exceeds 52428800 bytes or if health/query responsiveness exceeds the fixture runner's one-second deadline.
Assert oldest-first eviction plus exact oversize, rejection, tail-drop, exporter-drop, eviction, and cursor-gap evidence.
Write the target, binary hash, configuration, samples, peak RSS, counters, and pass/fail result to the release evidence directory.
